from pathlib import Path
from zipfile import ZipFile, ZIP_DEFLATED
from lxml import etree
import shutil, tempfile, os

pptx = Path('/home/user/Desktop/164_3.pptx')
backup = pptx.with_suffix('.pptx.bak')
if not backup.exists():
    shutil.copy2(pptx, backup)

NS = {
    'a':'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main',
    'p':'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/presentationml/2006/main',
    'r':'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships',
    'rel':'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships',
    'ct':'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/content-types',
}
for prefix, uri in NS.items():
    if prefix not in ('rel','ct'):
        etree.register_namespace(prefix, uri)
etree.register_namespace('', NS['rel'])

with ZipFile(pptx, 'r') as zin:
    entries = {info.filename: zin.read(info.filename) for info in zin.infolist()}
    infos = {info.filename: info for info in zin.infolist()}

# Slide 2: bold title and add note/body text matching title.
slide_name = 'ppt/slides/slide2.xml'
slide = etree.fromstring(entries[slide_name])
spTree = slide.find('.//p:spTree', NS)
title_text = 'Team Members'

for sp in slide.xpath('.//p:sp[p:nvSpPr/p:nvPr/p:ph[@type=\"title\"]]', namespaces=NS):
    for rpr in sp.xpath('.//a:rPr | .//a:endParaRPr', namespaces=NS):
        rpr.set('b', '1')

body_shapes = slide.xpath('.//p:sp[p:nvSpPr/p:nvPr/p:ph[not(@type)]]', namespaces=NS)
if body_shapes:
    body = body_shapes[0].find('p:txBody', NS)
    p = body.find('a:p', NS)
    for child in list(p):
        p.remove(child)
    pPr = etree.SubElement(p, '{%s}pPr' % NS['a'])
    etree.SubElement(pPr, '{%s}buNone' % NS['a'])
    r = etree.SubElement(p, '{%s}r' % NS['a'])
    rPr = etree.SubElement(r, '{%s}rPr' % NS['a'], b='0', lang='en-US', sz='3200')
    solid = etree.SubElement(rPr, '{%s}solidFill' % NS['a'])
    etree.SubElement(solid, '{%s}srgbClr' % NS['a'], val='000000')
    etree.SubElement(rPr, '{%s}latin' % NS['a'], typeface='Calibri')
    t = etree.SubElement(r, '{%s}t' % NS['a'])
    t.text = title_text
    end = etree.SubElement(p, '{%s}endParaRPr' % NS['a'], b='0', lang='en-US', sz='3200')
    solid = etree.SubElement(end, '{%s}solidFill' % NS['a'])
    etree.SubElement(solid, '{%s}srgbClr' % NS['a'], val='000000')
    etree.SubElement(end, '{%s}latin' % NS['a'], typeface='Calibri')
entries[slide_name] = etree.tostring(slide, xml_declaration=True, encoding='UTF-8', standalone=False)

# Add a proper notesSlide part for slide 2 containing the same note text.
notes_name = 'ppt/notesSlides/notesSlide1.xml'
notes_rels_name = 'ppt/notesSlides/_rels/notesSlide1.xml.rels'

      <p:sp>
        <p:nvSpPr><p:cNvPr id=\"2\" name=\"Notes Placeholder 1\"/><p:cNvSpPr><a:spLocks noGrp=\"1\"/></p:cNvSpPr><p:nvPr><p:ph type=\"body\" idx=\"1\"/></p:nvPr></p:nvSpPr>
        <p:spPr><a:xfrm><a:off x=\"685800\" y=\"3884613\"/><a:ext cx=\"5486400\" cy=\"3600450\"/></a:xfrm><a:prstGeom prst=\"rect\"><a:avLst/></a:prstGeom><a:noFill/><a:ln w=\"0\"><a:noFill/></a:ln></p:spPr>
        <p:txBody><a:bodyPr/><a:lstStyle/><a:p><a:r><a:rPr lang=\"en-US\" sz=\"1200\"/><a:t>{title_text}</a:t></a:r><a:endParaRPr lang=\"en-US\" sz=\"1200\"/></a:p></p:txBody>
